value.name: 12' · Nemanja Bilbija v Lincoln Red Imps
value.narrative: Marko Vranjković: crosses from the right into the six-yard box. Nemanja Bilbija: finishes from point-blank range with his left foot.

sequence.note: Delivers a cross from the right side towards the six-yard box.
Left-footed finish from very close range into the middle of the goal.

value.name: 85' · Leo Mikić v Lincoln Red Imps
value.narrative: Matej Šakota: feeds Mikić after Lincoln lose the ball near their own goal. Leo Mikić: fires a right-footed shot from the middle of the box.

sequence.note: Supplies the assist after Lincoln give the ball away close to their goal.
Right-footed finish from the centre of the area into the middle of the net.
